briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race ahead as US tightens export controls on advanced chips

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs releasing upgraded models this month. US-China tensions over compute access are driving accelerated domestic investment. Safety concerns mount as production deployments expose new attack surfaces.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI launched o4 with 2.1T parameters and native multimodal reasoning. Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus focused on agentic workflows. DeepSeek R2 surprised with open weights matching GPT-4o performance at 40% lower inference cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins next quarter with fines up to 6% of global revenue.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra B300 clusters shipping to xAI and Microsoft. TSMC broke ground on three new Arizona fabs dedicated to AI accelerators. Amazon and Google each committed $4B+ to sovereign AI data centers in Europe and India.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first 10-trillion-parameter model cross the AGI threshold before 2028 or will scaling laws plateau earlier?
